instrucao: Continue the story in English: write 2 to 4 sentences. You can only see the last part! (Continuem a história em inglês.)
instrucaoFinal: Last round: write the END of the story! (Escrevam o final.)

propostas.texto: One morning, I found a strange box in my backpack.
My dog looked at me and said: "Good morning!"
After the storm, we woke up on a small island.
My grandmother gave me an old key and said: "Don't open the red door."
Last night, a spaceship landed in front of my school.
I received a message from an unknown number: "I know your secret."
